_about: The 'eighth criterion' adjustment each county property appraiser makes to a recorded sale price when arriving at just value (s. 193.011(8), F.S.), as filed with the Florida Department of Revenue on Form DR-493 for the 2026 roll. The buyer tax estimate uses: estimated just value = price x (1 - adjustment). Every use-code group on all three 2026 forms carries the same percentage, so one number per county is stored.
